draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.30, the 42nd-best grade among 251 2017 draftees and 5th of 14 at TE. He lasted until pick 145, well after his grade rank (42nd): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Zach Miller. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 546 receiving yards in 2016, 10th of 14 TEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2020. 8 career games and 4 starts over 2 completed seasons. Career-best season: 1 AV in 2018. Weak spots: approximate value 0 (9th percentile), team target share 0.8% (10th percentile).
